policy: A blocker may be closed only by fresh evidence satisfying the stated resolution gate. Installation, inferred readiness, dependency overrides, fallback adapters, and empty-session observations do not close a blocker.

blocking_conditions: worker stalled during MCP bootstrap before task execution
blockers.resolution_gate: Registered isolated benchmark workspace, reachable ready graph, live lifecycle events normalized into the ledger, and no session leakage using the v1.1 model policy.
blockers.safe_next_action: Run one isolated gpt-5.4 worker lifecycle probe through the approved ORCA adapter; preserve redacted lifecycle evidence and stop if normalization or cleanup is not complete.

blocking_conditions: native event stream/subscription is not exposed
full worker session semantic parity remains unverified
gpt-5.4 model execution is not verified
blockers.resolution_gate: Approved isolated session test proves spawn, polling lifecycle transitions, ledger bridge, cleanup, zero cross-run state leakage, and gpt-5.4 execution; any native-event limitation is explicitly recorded.
blockers.safe_next_action: Keep polling bounded and redacted; run the approved isolated gpt-5.4 session probe only if its lifecycle and cleanup evidence can be captured.

blocking_conditions: live lifecycle ledger bridge not verified
blockers.resolution_gate: Declare a stable CLI path, resolve workspace/config, authenticate an allowed provider in an isolated profile, bind a gpt-5.4 session, and prove lifecycle plus ledger emission.
blockers.safe_next_action: Do not authenticate automatically; after operator/provider setup, rerun the read-only status, binding, and lifecycle probes under the v1.1 model policy.

blocking_conditions: normal dependency resolution failed for all tested versions
blockers.resolution_gate: Clean pinned environment resolves the declared SDK/tool/workspace graph without --no-deps or dependency overrides, then passes workspace, permissions, and ledger probes.
blockers.safe_next_action: Wait for or identify an upstream-compatible dependency set; do not weaken the resolver policy.

blocking_conditions: full task semantic parity not verified
blockers.resolution_gate: The declared v1.1 execution model/provider snapshot succeeds in the isolated container with network and permissions recorded, then task lifecycle and ledger parity pass.
blockers.safe_next_action: Prepare a non-production credential boundary and model manifest; do not call a provider during preflight.

blocking_conditions: integrated fixture is provider-free and does not prove a real controlled task
provider-backed task semantic parity and matched OFF comparison remain unverified
blockers.resolution_gate: Public source is isolated and version-pinned, all declared ON component actions are mapped to ledger-compatible events in a controlled v1.1 task, and the matched OFF control remains unchanged.
blockers.safe_next_action: Use the integrated fixture as the preflight gate, then obtain explicit controlled model/auth configuration before any model-backed session.
